value.name: Intimidating Presence
value.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies of your choice within 15 feet that can see or hear you
value.effect: Intimidating Presence. Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn, then repeats the save. A second failure extends the fear one final round. A creature that succeeds becomes immune to this use. This never forces surrender; NPC surrender remains a Director decision.

source.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Use your mutated appearance to frighten enemies, potentially causing them to flee or surrender.

records.value: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. At Warrior level 1 choose Strength or Dexterity as your Warrior ability; this choice is permanent in this draft. S = 1/2/3/4 at Warrior levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, chosen Warrior ability modifier). Warrior technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Warrior technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + chosen modifier. Source basis: approved Player Rulebook extract and preserved class registry.

value.name: Frightened
value.coreText: Disadvantage while source is visible and cannot willingly move closer.
compatibleV6Details: V6 specifies disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight, and prohibits willingly moving closer.
value.effect: While the source of fear is visible/in line of sight, the creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls. While Frightened it cannot willingly move closer to that source.
value.application: Each application records its fear source.
value.durationAndEnding: Use the applying effect's duration and repeat-save procedure.
value.stacking: Separate fear sources are tracked independently. Disadvantage does not stack.
value.immunitiesAndOverrides: Fear immunity blocks application. Forced movement may move the creature closer because the prohibition is on willing movement.
